intro: Two continents, a thousand years of history. That is Istanbul in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Istanbul
paragraphs: Istanbul (Europe / Asia) is known for its city, heritage and food experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is April to June and September to November.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai to Istanbul Airport.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Get an Istanbulkart for trams, metro and ferries.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Istanbul?
faq.a: April to June and September to November.
Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai to Istanbul Airport.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Istanbul?
faq.a: Popular choices: Sultanahmet for sights; Karaköy / Galata for cafés; Kadıköy on the Asian side.
